props.name: controller
props.description: The controller managing this component's state and behaviour. Bind to it to access the component's imperative API.

props.name: onfirstcreate
props.description: Fires when the component's controller is first created.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the list runs. Vertical is a column of rows, horizontal a row of columns.

props.name: key
props.description: The target key, used when a layout is exported or imported.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the list's grid element (the place for `gap-*`).

props.name: containerClass
props.description: Classes for the element wrapping the grid.

props.name: boardClass
props.description: Classes for the board's root element.

props.name: config
props.description: Board configuration merged over the preset's defaults, which make widgets fully draggable. Anything a FlexiBoard accepts: callbacks, registry, layouts.

props.name: targetConfig
props.description: Target configuration merged over the preset's. `direction` fixes the layout, and sizing and widget defaults are yours to set.
